'''Crematorium I''' is a blueprint that can be build in the [[Morgue]].

Here, the [[Keeper]] can cremate [[corpses]] to dispose of them and obtain {{Item|Ash|5}} and {{Item|Salt|1}} in return. With the [[Cremator]] [[Perks|perk]], the amount of materials obtained is doubled.
